title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

excerpt.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

随着他们敬爱领袖的死去，[raider_khanate.GetName]再度掀起一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主刀兵相见，只为争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产————帝国的继承权。究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
excerpt.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

title.en: The Death of the Great Khan

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是被[great_khan.GetHerHis]手下一位有野心的领主毒杀而死。

texts.en:
Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are scarce at this point, but intercepted communications indicate that the Great Khan was poisoned by one of [great_khan.GetHerHis] more ambitious warlords in an attempted coup.

With their beloved leader gone, a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！根据我们截获到的信息，大可汗的死因是没能抵御住名为萨拉凯利安热病的病魔侵袭，这是[raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural]的一种常见而致命的疾病，是[raider_khanate.GetName]崛起前其太空站恶劣生活环境的遗产。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! According to intercepted communications, the Great Khan succumbed to Sarakellian Fever, a relatively common and often fatal disease found among [raider_khanate.GetSpeciesNamePlural] - a legacy of the poor living conditions on the space stations where most of them lived before the rise of the [raider_khanate.GetName].

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了! 截留到的信息显示，大可汗是被一个未知的星际势力派遣出的特种部队刺杀。目前没有任何一个政府对此事表示负责。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Intercepted communications suggest that the Great Khan was violently assassinated by a special forces team in the employ of an as yet unidentified galactic power. No government has been willing to claim responsibility for this operation.

texts.zh: [raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗[great_khan.GetName]死了！具体细节尚不明朗，但我们截获到的信息显示，大可汗是在[great_khan.GetHerHis]旗舰上[great_khan.GetHerHis]的私人房间被一名外星姬妾刺杀。刺杀动机不明。
texts.en: Great Khan [great_khan.GetName] of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead! Details are vague, but intercepted transmissions have revealed that the Great Khan was murdered by an alien concubine in [great_khan.GetHerHis] private chambers onboard [great_khan.GetHerHis] flagship. The motive is unknown.

texts.zh:
[raider_khanate.GetName]的大可汗死了！根据目前截留到的信息，[great_khan.GetName][great_khan.GetHerHis]由于年老，在几天前无疾而终了。

尽管人们相信可汗指定了一位继承人，但[raider_khanate.GetName]还是掀起了一场争权夺利的腥风血雨。大可汗手下的领主们正为了争夺[great_khan.GetHerHis]的遗产——帝国的控制权而兵戎相见，究竟谁能笑到最后还未可知。
texts.en:
The Great Khan of the [raider_khanate.GetName] is dead. According to intercepted transmissions, [great_khan.GetName] passed away naturally at some point during the last few days as a result of [great_khan.GetHerHis] advanced age.

It is believed that the Great Khan had appointed a designated successor, but despite this a vicious power struggle has erupted in the [raider_khanate.GetName]. The Great Khan's warlords are now fighting each other over control of [great_khan.GetHerHis] empire. It remains to be seen who will emerge on top.

texts.zh:
大可汗去世之后混乱和动乱随之而来，我们作为帝国中的辖地的历史一去不返——我们宣誓效忠的目标仅仅是大可汗。我们现在又可以追寻我们自己的命运了。

驻扎在[Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName]的汗国全体军事人员都离开他们的哨所回到自己的人民当中去了，第一次拆除之后剩余的军事用品都留在了那里。
texts.en:
With chaos and instability following in the wake of the Great Khan's death, our status as a Satrapy within the Horde is void - our oath of fealty was to the Great Khan alone. We are once more free to pursue our own destiny.

All Horde military personnel that were stationed in the [Root.Capital.solar_system.GetName] system have abandoned their posts to join their people elsewhere, after first demolishing any war material left behind.

texts.zh:
大可汗的逝去导致了[From.GetName]的崩溃。没有了强势的统治者，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]又一次陷入了内斗。帝国在各个继业者，最强大也最有权势的高级军官们，的领导下分为数派。

每一派都自称为星帐的大可汗，不允许任何人的质疑。[From.GetSpeciesName]团结一心的日子走到了尽头。
texts.en:
The death of the Great Khan has proved the undoing of the [From.GetName]. Without a strong ruler to unite them, the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have succumbed to infighting once more. Their empire has been divided between the Diadochi, the most powerful and influential of the Great Khan's military commanders.

Each of them now claims the title of Great Khan of the Galaxy, and their supporters are locked in bitter opposition to one another. The time of a united [From.GetSpeciesName] empire is apparently at an end.

label.en: It was not meant to be.

texts.zh: 由于新汗国在维持大可汗的征伐时遇到困难，其将军决定进一步巩固其战斗军力。因此，他们从各附庸国的驻军空间站中调取了全部人员，并拆除了空间站。
texts.en: As the New Khanate struggles to maintain its hold over the Great Khan's conquests, its military leadership has decided to further consolidate their forces. Consequently, they have withdrawn the personnel from all of their vassal garrison stations and scuttled them.

texts.zh:
出人意料地，[From.GetSpeciesName]帝国成功挺过了大可汗死后的种种波动。由于新可汗立刻加冕，也完全消灭了大家分道扬镳的念头。

目前来说，重获新生的[From.GetSpeciesName]似乎把重心放在了巩固已有疆土之上，对于新的征程兴趣不大。
texts.en:
Against all odds, the [From.GetSpeciesName] Horde has managed to weather the turmoil that followed in the wake of the death of the Great Khan. The immediate threat of splintering into different successor states has been largely eliminated with the coronation of a new khan.

For now, this reborn [From.GetSpeciesName] Khanate seems more concerned with the consolidation of the territory it already controls than making new conquests.

label.zh: 就看看他们能苟活到什么时候。
label.en: We shall see how long they survive.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

汗国的前辖地都收到了作为平等个体加入该联邦的邀请，或者他们也可选择不加入并要回完全的独立主权。
texts.en:
The power struggle that erupted in the [From.GetName] upon the death of the Great Khan has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now seeks to reform their government along the lines of an interstellar federation.

The former Satrapies of the Horde have been given the offer to join this new federation as equal partners, or to formally secede and have their full independence returned.

label.en: We shall see what comes of this.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

作为汗国的辖地，我们受邀作为奠基成员加入该联邦。除此之外，汗国最近还起草了一份宪法，允许我们脱离，以及重新建立完全独立的主权。
texts.en:
The power struggle that erupted in the [From.GetName] upon the death of the Great Khan has come to an end. A new democratic faction, inspired by egalitarian values that were alien to the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] when they began their war of conquest, now seeks to reform their government along the lines of an interstellar federation.

As a Satrapy of the Horde, we have been asked to participate in this new federation as a founding member. Alternatively, the Horde's recently drafted constitution would also allow us to secede and establish full independence once again.

label.zh: 我们就加入这个新的联邦吧。
label.en: We shall join this new federation.

[From.GetName]在大可汗死后陷入的权力斗争终于划上句号。由于[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]在征服的途中见识到了闻所未闻的平等主义思想，一个新成立的民主派系寻求通过星际联邦的方式对帝国政体进行改革。

汗国的前辖地都收到了作为平等个体加入该联邦的邀请，或者他们也可选择不加入并要回完全的独立主权。

The former Satrapies of the Horde have been given the offer to join this new federation as equal partners, or to formally secede and have their full independence returned.

texts.zh:
大可汗去世之前，有很多的改革工作正在进行中，旨在将[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]从一个个松散无序的部族变成一个团结有力的星际帝国。现在大可汗的去世让这所有的改革瞬间消失殆尽。

所有继承大可汗的军阀们都没有对这些改革展现一丝兴趣，而[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]也都回归了以前的掠夺者行事方式。[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]已成一盘散沙。
texts.en:
The death of the Great Khan has also proved the killing blow for the many reforms that were instituted by the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to turn their disorganized marauder clans into a consolidated galactic empire.

None of the warlords who succeeded the Great Khan have shown the least bit of interest in continuing these reforms, and the [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have all reverted to the old ways of their violent marauder past. The [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are united no longer.
